newsitem.title: USA: Great Lakes Aviation Dec load factor up.
newsitem.headline: Great Lakes Aviation Dec load factor up.

text.p: Great Lakes Aviation Ltd said Thursday its December passenger load factor rose 2.5 percentage points to 44.2 percent from 41.7 percent a year ago.
Available seat miles increased 13.5 percent to 55.0 million from 48.5 million, and revenue pasenger miles jumped 20.4 percent to 24.3 million from 20.2 million.

Year to date, the carrier said its load factor was up 0.3 point to 44.2 percent from 43.9 percent. Available seat miles increased 19.8 percent to 678.3 million from 566.3 million, and revenue passenger miles rose 20.5 percent to 299.6 million from 248.6 million.
